title: Evidence
description: A specific piece of content extracted from a source that is directly relevant to a claim. Evidence is always tied to a specific source and a specific location within that source.

source_id.description: The source this evidence is extracted from. Must reference an existing Source entity.

claim_ids.description: The claim(s) this evidence bears on. Must have at least one claim. Evidence must not be orphaned.

description.description: What this evidence is and why it is relevant to the associated claims.

quote.description: Direct verbatim quotation from the source. Preferred over paraphrase where possible.

location.description: Specific location within the source: page number, paragraph, timestamp, section, or line range.

interpretation.description: Optional: what the investigator takes this evidence to mean, kept separate from the raw extraction.

evidence_type.description: How this evidence relates to the associated claim(s).

reliability_notes.description: Any notes about the reliability or limitations of this specific piece of evidence.
